gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-gudea: Expressive and a bit playful, Shantell Sans draws every curve with one fixed nib width. Gudea follows in a modern sans with glass-clear gaps at the stroke ends, so the text stays easy to follow.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-hanken-grotesk: Wide-mouthed and hand-made in feel, this heading never lets its line thicken or thin. Hanken Grotesk is the sans that gives it structure, with a wire-bent look and wide channels leading into each counter.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-host-grotesk: Shantell Sans is loud and personal, with a fixed nib width and no brush swell anywhere in its strokes. Host Grotesk is the sans that stays quiet, sweeping its curves open instead of curling them closed.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-hubot-sans: Hubot Sans sets a contemporary sans-serif body with an e opened wide and no brush-style swell anywhere. Shantell Sans on top brings the personality, with a mouth wide as a tin can's cut lid.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-ar: Shantell Sans brings a rounded-wire stroke and a wide mouth to the heading, drawn with one fixed nib width. IBM Plex Sans Arabic carries the text with open apertures, and you can size it up a little for comfort.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-de: Expressive from the first word, Shantell Sans cuts its letters like laser-cut sheet, one cutting width throughout. And IBM Plex Sans Devanagari answers with rope-loose curves that never knot at the ends.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-he: Distinctive in every line, Shantell Sans lets curves and straights share a single width, with a wide mouth. IBM Plex Sans Hebrew sits underneath as a plain sans, its s and c left open and uncrowded.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-jp: IBM Plex Sans JP reads as an approachable sans-serif, each curve ending in a clean, open gap. Over a longer passage it feels steady and unfussy, while Shantell Sans above it keeps its bent-paperclip look with no swelling.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-kr: Bent like a plotter pen's work, Shantell Sans draws one single-weight line with a wide mouth. And IBM Plex Sans KR, a plain sans, keeps every curve end open, so a longer stretch reads smoothly.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-ibm-plex-sans-th: Shantell Sans draws a wide-mouthed heading with no vertical emphasis and no horizontal thinning anywhere. IBM Plex Sans Thai, a plain sans, keeps a longer passage moving, its c ends pointing apart like open pincers.
